parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> Call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to obtain the policy ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
